slices.goal: Build the read-only spec-loop dashboard HTTP server + run-discovery/JSON data layer as a single stdlib-only Python script `scripts/dashboard_server.py` (matching the 'standard library only' idiom of scripts/release.py and scripts/validate_marketplace.py: module docstring, main()->int, __main__ guard; zero third-party deps; NO node/npm/build tooling). It has two clean layers. (A) A PURE, importable data layer `scan_runs(docs_root)` that REUSES THE EXACT derivation rules of the existing read-only terminal command plugins/spec-loop/commands/dashboard.md — do NOT invent a second source of truth. Specifically: discover runs by globbing `docs/spec-loop/*/dag.json` under the root (this repo's runs only; this run's scope is THIS REPO ONLY — no machine-wide/cross-repo scan); for each run read dag.json {base_ref,base_sha,slices:[{id,goal,files,subsystems,deps,risk_tier,depth,parent,status}]} (status in pending|complete|split; dag.json is SOLE authority for ids/deps/depth/parent/waves) plus siblings request.md, escalations.md, decisions-log.md, and per-slice slice-<id>-report.md (durable) presence; DERIVE waves (a wave = every pending slice whose deps are all complete; iterate to assign later pending slices to the first satisfying wave); treat status:'split' as TERMINAL (does not block dependents); honor the <parent-id>.N child convention (depth=parent.depth+1, parent=<parent-id>); derive HONEST per-slice labels exactly as dashboard.md does — complete | split | awaiting-human (pending + OPEN escalation) | redispatch-pending (pending + ANSWERED escalation) | runnable-pending (pending, no open escalation, all deps complete) | blocked-pending (pending, no open escalation, >=1 dep incomplete); never claim a slice is 'running now' from cold artifacts. Parse BOTH OPEN-escalation marker forms (escalation-gate `## [<slice-id>] ... (status: OPEN)` AND iron-council `## [<id|intake>] Iron Council objects: ... (status: OPEN)`), including the intake-scoped form that joins no slice. slice-<id>-split.json is ADVISORY only (no id/depth/parent) — never read DAG structure from it. TOLERATE a half-written dag.json: wrap each run's parse in try/except and emit that run with a status like 'unreadable' (mirroring the command's 'state momentarily unreadable') WITHOUT dropping other runs, crashing, or inventing state; treat any individually-missing optional artifact as simply absent. (B) A read-only HTTP layer on stdlib http.server with HARD security guardrails (the Guardian's mandatory list): GET/HEAD ONLY (405 on anything else; NO POST/PUT/DELETE, no mutation/trigger/resume endpoint, no shell-out, no file writes); bind 127.0.0.1 ONLY (never 0.0.0.0); a Host-header allowlist (accept only 127.0.0.1:<port> / localhost:<port>, reject all else — anti-DNS-rebinding); path-traversal-safe run resolution that ENUMERATES the discovered run dirs and matches by exact basename (never os.path.join(root, client_input)), and for any file read canonicalizes via os.path.realpath and ASSERTS the result stays under the bounded docs/spec-loop/ root (reject '..', absolute paths, null bytes, escaping symlinks -> 404); no directory listing; bounded response/run count; serve the static frontend from a FIXED bundled assets dir (e.g. scripts/dashboard_assets/) distinct from the scanned data root. Endpoints: GET /api/runs (JSON: all runs in this repo, each with derived waves + honest labels + a one-line request excerpt + counts) and GET /api/runs/<id> (JSON detail: dag, derived waves/labels, OPEN escalations both forms incl. intake, decisions-log tail, per-slice durable-report presence); add an ETag/mtime check so unchanged runs return 304. Flags: --port (default e.g. 8787) and --root (default cwd). Ship a MINIMAL but functional dark placeholder scripts/dashboard_assets/index.html so the server is independently shippable/verifiable end-to-end (s2 replaces it with the full UI). ALSO add `scripts/test_dashboard_server.py` — stdlib unittest, since validate_marketplace.py does NOT lint scripts/*.py — covering: scan_runs over a temp fixture dir including a DELIBERATELY-CORRUPT dag.json (that run -> unreadable, others survive); wave derivation incl. a split parent + its <parent>.N children; and the risky HTTP paths written first (a run-id like ../../etc/passwd returns 404 not a file; a foreign Host header is rejected; a non-GET method returns 405). Run state lives under docs/spec-loop/<run-id>/ per spec-loop.md. Do NOT touch CHANGELOG/READMEs/plugin.json/marketplace.json here — the release ritual + launcher command + full UI are s2. Verify: `python3 scripts/test_dashboard_server.py` green AND `python3 scripts/validate_marketplace.py` exits 0; manually curl /api/runs against this repo (it should surface run 20260625-dashboard-cmd and this run).

Build the modern dark-theme web frontend + the read-only launcher command + the full release ritual, on top of s1's server/JSON contract. (1) FRONTEND: replace the minimal scripts/dashboard_assets/index.html (and add any sibling css/js in scripts/dashboard_assets/ if you split files) with a self-contained, modern DARK-THEME single-page UI — hand-written CSS + vanilla JS, NO framework, NO build step, NO third-party deps (consistent with this zero-dep repo; the page is served by s1's static layer). It consumes s1's JSON API and renders, per the existing terminal dashboard's output blocks: an all-runs overview (list/cards of every run in this repo with run-id, base_ref@sha excerpt, status rollup counts, recency) and a single-run drill-down (header run-id + base_ref@base_sha + one-line request excerpt; a DAG/wave listing Wave 0,1,... with each slice's derived readiness label; a slice table id|goal(truncated)|tier|depth|parent|deps|status; a status rollup with counts + which slices are runnable-now and which are awaiting-human; OPEN escalations both marker forms incl. intake-scoped; recent decisions = decisions-log tail). Render the honest derived labels with clear visual treatment; show a run whose dag.json is 'unreadable' as a transient state, never an error/crash. (2) NEAR-REAL-TIME: the page POLLS the API on an interval (~2-3s) for near-real-time updates, with a visible freshness/last-updated indicator and graceful handling of the 304/unchanged path so it doesn't repaint needlessly; it must degrade gracefully if the server is momentarily unreachable. This is client-side only — strictly READ-ONLY, no controls that trigger/resume/mutate runs. (3) LAUNCHER COMMAND: add plugins/spec-loop/commands/dashboard-serve.md — a read-only command following the dashboard.md/quality-gate.md authoring convention (YAML frontmatter MUST include a `description` key or scripts/validate_marketplace.py:186-190 fails CI; argument-hint for optional --port/--root; a short read-only intro stating it starts a local read-only server and mutates NO run state). Its body explains running `python3 scripts/dashboard_server.py [--port N] [--root PATH]` and opening the printed http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ URL. Use a DISTINCT command name `dashboard-serve` — do NOT collide with the existing `/spec-loop:dashboard` terminal command. (4) RELEASE RITUAL (owed, per every prior feature; do NOT touch .claude-plugin/marketplace.json): add a `### Added` line under CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] describing the web dashboard + dashboard-serve command; add a Components-table row in plugins/spec-loop/README.md for the `dashboard-serve` command; update the top-level README.md command enumeration (the directory-tree comment around line 88 listing the commands) to include the web dashboard; and bump plugins/spec-loop/.claude-plugin/plugin.json version following the ALPHA-channel convention (currently 1.1.0-alpha.1 — inspect scripts/release.py + the CHANGELOG channel table to choose the correct next alpha version for an additive feature; additive => minor). Verify: `python3 scripts/validate_marketplace.py` exits 0; launch the server and confirm the dark-theme page loads at 127.0.0.1, renders this repo's runs from the live API, and auto-refreshes; confirm the read-only contract (no mutating endpoints/controls).
